adoptedSchedule.meaning: Editorial review dates, not statutory deadlines or a promise that every result will be final.

scope.Maine: Corrected/certified initial-choice counts before RCV rank promotion; preserve exact report measurement and source field. If unavailable, keep pair pending rather than substitute Round1.
scope.partyTruth: Actual official operative D/R/O identity under the fixed 50-state codebook; frozen forecast probabilities are never rewritten to match result-time affiliation.

automaticScorecard: Live-current predictions and matching reviewed reference metadata follow the active site publication. This policy decision does not freeze the live display to an old forecast edition.
